description_full: MONTHLY DROP-IN TRANSITION SESSIONS Wednesday, November 4, 2026 9-10:00 a.m. Virtual Event Drop into the Google Meet on the first Wednesday of each month to ask your specific transition questions. Meghan Smallwood, Secondary and Transition Services Resource Teacher, will help you navigate the process of transitioning from high school to adult life for your student with a disability. For questions, please contact Meghan at meghan_smallwood@hcpss.org or (443) 355-7733. Visit November meeting link . This event is sponsored by HCPSS and aligns with the questions about the school system offering training about special education issues and providing information on agencies that can assist in the transition from school on the MDSE parent survey that is sent to families of students with an IEP or IFSP annually. Free

title: TERPS EXCEED OPEN HOUSE
description: TERPS EXCEED OPEN HOUSE Wednesday, November 4, 2026 4:30-6:30 p.m. University of Maryland College Park, MD Come learn about TerpsEXCEED at the University of Maryland, College Park. TerpsEXCEED is an…
description_full: TERPS EXCEED OPEN HOUSE Wednesday, November 4, 2026 4:30-6:30 p.m. University of Maryland College Park, MD Come learn about TerpsEXCEED at the University of Maryland, College Park. TerpsEXCEED is an inclusive post-secondary education program that provides Maryland students with intellectual disabilities the opportunity to participate in a college experience for two years, culminating in a certificate. We ask that each family only bring two people (the prospective student plus one additional person) as we have space restrictions. There will be a presentation, Q&A, and a tour. https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf9ZRMQIFrRfV1ZAaeOn27OxV2IcQClz1XsNKevDYW47DfwaA/viewform Learn more about Terps EXCEED. https://education.umd.edu/terpsexceed Free

title: SMALL CHILDREN, BIG FEELINGS: HELPING YOUR CHILD, AND YOURSELF, WHEN BEHAVIORS FEEL CHALLENGING
description: SMALL CHILDREN, BIG FEELINGS: HELPING YOUR CHILD, AND YOURSELF, WHEN BEHAVIORS FEEL CHALLENGING Wednesday, November 4, 2026 6:00-7:30 p.m. Virtual Event Young children sometimes have BIG feelings…
description_full: SMALL CHILDREN, BIG FEELINGS: HELPING YOUR CHILD, AND YOURSELF, WHEN BEHAVIORS FEEL CHALLENGING Wednesday, November 4, 2026 6:00-7:30 p.m. Virtual Event Young children sometimes have BIG feelings, and often those feelings show up in ways that challenge the adults in their lives. Join us to gain a deeper understanding of behavior and learn positive, practical strategies to support your child and yourself. Attend this workshop to learn: How children’s brains develop and how that relates to behavior Positive approaches to dealing with behaviors How sensory differences may impact children’s behavior Distinguishing tantrums from meltdowns and how to respond to both Resources for supporting children when behaviors feel challenging Presented by Kristen Paul, PPMD’s director of early childhood programs. Visit registration page. Sponsored by Parents’ Place of Maryland. Free
